coverage:
Read in full: devbob MEMORY.md and its 70 live notes. For all 374 files in the devbob _archive_2026_07_03, extracted the frontmatter descriptions; about 45 were read in depth. Also read in full the 18 substrate-utils notes (8 of them closely) and every note in metabob-mcp (3), metabob-dashboard (9), exp-repo (3), vast-ai (2), scratch-perspective (6), scratch (10; this is a separate game project, so only substrate-eval-state is relevant) and the probe stub in /tmp/imp-audit-proj.

Live read-only checks on node 1:
- SurrealDB: namespaces; concept census (88,565 rows, 76,812 of them impulse_signature); surrealdb_gotcha rows (582 rows, 8 distinct); phrase probes for the 07-03 distillation, with a positive control; upkeep_stats (0 rows); execution (150,267 rows).
- The memory store files: 680 notes from 05-27 to 07-23; a 09-22 pre-merge backup with 1,077; 09-23 backups with 1,788; the live store with 59 notes, oldest 09-26.
- The dev-vessel git log for 09-21 to 09-27.
- The activity-api trace-retention journal.

Framing corrections:
- Nothing here predates 01-30. The devbob memory spans 04-22 to 07-08, so 01-30 to 04-22 is an uncovered hole.
- Devbob and substrate-utils have no transcripts. The metabob-mcp and metabob-dashboard transcripts (9 files, about 20 MB) were not mined.

Disclosure: I wrote one scratch file, /tmp/devbob_arch_desc.txt. The output file was written successfully.

problems.symptom: Trace table bloats, reads take seconds, the retention mechanism is 'enabled' but not enforcing or failing batches
problems.root_cause: unbounded high-frequency lifecycle writes; retention survey and deletes run on the overloaded table they must bound; no upkeep record read back

problems.symptom: The system's memory is split, archived, or reset; recall returns nothing old or ignores the topic
problems.root_cause: store path depends on WORKSPACE_ROOT resolution; bulk migrations and cleanups operate on the store without a preservation check; no shape entry point for 'memory' in goal inference

problems.symptom: Gate passes changes that do nothing (dead code, semantic no-op, inert write)
problems.root_cause: gates read the diff or typecheck; none measures the defect behaviour

problems.symptom: Re-emitted gaps, scenarios, templates, and concepts multiply; counters wiped on re-emit
problems.root_cause: ids derived with volatile tokens; blind UPSERT overwrite; per-execution writers

problems.symptom: Producer answers but the caller sees no producer or silence (pinned ports, loopback registrations, wrong envelope)
problems.root_cause: writers pin peer endpoints or URL formats; registration writes the transport address; fail-soft to empty

problems.symptom: Self-edit breaks the authoring vessel itself (crash-loop, bootstrap deadlock)
problems.root_cause: no parse or duplicate-identifier check on the vessel's own source before cutover restart

problems.symptom: A query or measurement artifact is read as system state and published, then retracted
problems.root_cause: single uncontrolled reads: oldest-first lists, prefix filters, pagination truncation, stale caches, fail-soft empty responses, green CI on zero work

problems.symptom: Posteriors frozen, poisoned by benign no-ops, or fabricated; the bandit never demotes a 100%-failing activity
problems.root_cause: outcomes lack distinguishable failure modes; signatures missing; counters keyed differently across tables

problems.symptom: Work and measurement are on different nodes; hub lacks location-stateful producers
problems.root_cause: loop runs on the spoke (9199 of ~9200/day) while the hub is inspected; loopback registrations

problems.symptom: Committed fix not running (stale process, read-only bind, dirty-submodule skip, masked services, wrong branch, submodule bump never ran)
problems.root_cause: multiple deploy channels per vessel type with silent skip semantics

problems.symptom: Capability silently off because an env var is unset; new env gates minted while old ones are removed
problems.root_cause: behaviour and tuning parameters placed in env rather than shaped impulses

problems.symptom: Probes, mitosis dirs, AI-authored vessels, and scratch namespaces persist in live state
problems.root_cause: probe processes self-register and are mirrored; no teardown or retraction path

problems.symptom: Built mechanism wired but never exercised (0 executions, connected-but-yielding-nothing, live endpoint unused)
problems.root_cause: writers or resolvers minted without a scheduled caller or reader

problems.symptom: Drafter emits wrong schema, hallucinated paths, bad anchors, duplicate declarations, or runs with unbound variables
problems.root_cause: LLM given prose specs and big files; dispatch paths drop variable-carrying impulses

problems.symptom: Goal described as a capability finds no target shape and runs leftovers
problems.root_cause: target inference text-driven; shape vocabulary facts not available at inference time

problems.symptom: Human channel built but response half unregistered or dispatch dead
problems.root_cause: respond/grade resolvers unregistered; escalations pinned to a replaced vessel

problems.symptom: DB CPU pegged; cutover restart storms interrupt dispatches
problems.root_cause: self-amplifying write storms; restarts without drain

problems.symptom: Spoke consumes from hub but is not seen; federated arm never selected
problems.root_cause: relay reservation staleness; prefer-local routing; cost term cannot price cold arms

problems.symptom: Duplicate tables, dead vessels, and conflicting dashboards remain in tree and DB

principles: (05-23) System memory is authoritative and files are a cache. Restated at least 3 times since, and violated each time a migration, merge or retire ran without a preservation check.
(06-06) Walk the cutover boundaries (proposal-parse, cutover-evidence, intent-emit, host-sync) explicitly. Each has a distinct refusal class.
(06-14) Summary fields and list endpoints lie (template.metrics is 0, lists are oldest-first). Measure the store itself.
(06-16) Every bug class ships with the detector that would have caught it (the law 6 precursor).
(06-17) A benign no-op is not a failure. Failures must carry an error or failure mode, or the posterior is poisoned.
(06-19) A landing is a pushed substrate-authored commit, not an apply record.
(06-21) Reuse before mint.
(06-22) A writer that pins a peer's endpoint cannot learn the peer moved (obsidian host:27183, three months before :8270).
(06-25) Typecheck is not a fix. Code cutovers need a semantic or behavioural gate, orthogonal to the reach gate.
(06-28) 'Just firing will not count': success is a commit on origin/dev with no intervention.
(06-30) When behaviour contradicts a committed fix, compare the process start time with the file mtime first.
(07-01) A blind UPSERT on re-emission destroys accumulated learning state. Merge-preserve consumer-written counters.
(07-04) Silent fallback chains are the enemy. One env gate hid three silent layers.
(07-04) Ground truth is the git-home commit plus the deployed source, never the dispatch status.
(07-05) Placement follows data locality.
(08-08) 'Did it actually do anything, or does it only look fine?' A green or quiet subsystem is not evidence.
(08-08) Run the existing thing with corrected inputs before scoping a build. Check whether the deployed artifact predates HEAD.
(08-08) A dedup index over operator-touchable storage must treat stored rows as untrusted. One bad row that throws is an outage.
(08-10) Never collapse 'tool failed' into 'tool found nothing', or 'this address failed' into 'the host is down'. Probe by resolving a shape only the target serves.
(08-10) A blocker classification is a hypothesis. Re-probe before reporting.
(08-10) Any process started inside a spoke self-registers and is mirrored fleet-wide. Retract it explicitly.
(08-06) Capacity and spend knobs are the user's decisions. Diagnose before changing and before reverting.
(meta) At least 11 diagnoses in this shard were reversed within a day. Publishing from a single uncontrolled read is the generator of the 'proclaimed resolved' pattern.
